premise: Mouse squeaks hello into the hollow tree and a giant voice answers; Deer and Rabbit come to see; the giant is Mouse's own echo, and he shouts again on purpose.
inspiration: Folk echo tales (The Dog and the Echo), turned: nothing to fear in the hollow; the biggest voice in the forest turns out to be the smallest friend's own.
lesson: Even the smallest voice can sound big, and what surprises you is often just you.

en-US.title: Mouse and the Big Echo
en-US.text: At the edge of the meadow stood a hollow tree with a big dark doorway. Mouse stood in front of it. He was very small. The doorway was very big. Hello? said Mouse, in his tiny voice. {tree:pulse 0.4} HELLO, said the tree, in a great big voice. Mouse {mouse:hop} jumped. Then he {mouse:shake 0.4} giggled. Deer came {deer:pulse} trotting. Rabbit came {rabbit:hop x3} bouncing. There's a giant in there, whispered Mouse. Deer put his head into the doorway. Is anyone home? he asked, low and rumbly. Nothing. Rabbit tried. Hello-hello? Nothing at all. Mouse scratched his ear. Then he stepped up and squeaked as loud as he could: {mouse:pulse 0.9} I'M MOUSE! {tree:pulse 0.6} I'M MOUSE, boomed the tree. Deer blinked. Rabbit blinked. It only answers you, said Rabbit. So Mouse did it again. {mouse:hop x2} I'M MOUSE! And the biggest voice in the forest said, {tree:pulse 0.6} I'M MOUSE, right back.

es-ES.title: Ratón y el gran eco
es-ES.text: Al borde del prado había un árbol hueco con una puerta grande y oscura. Ratón se plantó delante. Él era muy pequeño. La puerta era muy grande. ¿Hola?, dijo Ratón con su vocecita. {tree:pulse 0.4} HOLA, dijo el árbol con un vozarrón. Ratón {mouse:hop} dio un brinco. Y luego {mouse:shake 0.4} se rio. Ciervo llegó {deer:pulse} al trote. Conejo llegó {rabbit:hop x3} a saltos. Ahí dentro hay un gigante, susurró Ratón. Ciervo metió la cabeza por la puerta. ¿Hay alguien?, preguntó, grave y hondo. Nada. Conejo probó. ¿Hola, hola? Nada de nada. Ratón se rascó una oreja. Entonces dio un paso y chilló con todas sus fuerzas: {mouse:pulse 0.9} ¡SOY RATÓN! {tree:pulse 0.6} SOY RATÓN, retumbó el árbol. Ciervo parpadeó. Conejo parpadeó. Solo te contesta a ti, dijo Conejo. Así que Ratón lo hizo otra vez. {mouse:hop x2} ¡SOY RATÓN! Y la voz más grande del bosque contestó: {tree:pulse 0.6} SOY RATÓN.

sound.note: a booming echo of the tiny hello
